sql: WITH h AS (SELECT s.prod_id,t.calendar_year y,t.calendar_month_number m,SUM(amount_sold) a FROM sales s JOIN customers c USING(cust_id) JOIN countries co USING(country_id) JOIN times t USING(time_id) JOIN promotions p USING(promo_id) JOIN channels ch USING(channel_id) WHERE co.country_name='France' AND p.promo_total_id=1 AND ch.channel_total_id=1 AND t.calendar_year IN(2019,2020) GROUP BY 1,2,3), paired AS (SELECT prod_id,m,MAX(CASE WHEN y=2019 THEN a END) a19,MAX(CASE WHEN y=2020 THEN a END) a20 FROM h GROUP BY 1,2), projected AS (SELECT prod_id,m,a19,a20,a20*a20/a19 projected,COALESCE(cur.to_us,1) rate FROM paired LEFT JOIN currency cur ON cur.country='France' AND cur.year=2021 AND cur.month=m WHERE a19>0 AND a20 IS NOT NULL), monthly AS (SELECT m,ROUND(AVG(projected*rate),2) monthly_avg FROM projected GROUP BY m) , ranked AS (SELECT monthly_avg,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY monthly_avg) rn,COUNT(*) OVER() n FROM monthly) SELECT AVG(monthly_avg) median_monthly_projected_sales_usd FROM ranked WHERE rn IN ((n+1)/2,(n+2)/2)
